integrity: Exact analytic proof; 137 independently computed rational flag-determinant cases in d=2..6 and 164 supplemental numerical checks. Finite computations supplement the proof. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: All-dimensional proof assumes regular Euclidean simplex, d>=2, strictly interior barycentric weights. The lower endpoint is unattained; no general irregular-simplex extension is claimed. Priority subject to unindexed literature.
title: Sharp volume balance for weighted Voronoi cells in regular simplices
